statement: Huawei's rotating chairman says the company lacks capacity to satisfy even Chinese demand and therefore has no plan for a full international expansion of Ascend.
why: The substitution threat from Ascend is capped by fabrication capacity, so outside China the practical alternative to merchant GPUs remains thin regardless of roadmap dates.

impact.mechanism: A self-declared capacity ceiling and no international go-to-market keeps Ascend out of non-China sockets, preserving merchant-GPU demand in the rest of the world.

evidence.excerpt: Since we don't have enough capacity to even satisfy the demand in China, we don't have a plan to expand into the international market in a fully-fledged way.

confidence.basis: Direct quote from Huawei's rotating chairman carried in secondary reporting; no capacity figures are given to size the ceiling.
